name: de.bookvia/bookvia
title: Bookvia
description: Find verified local businesses in Germany, read prices, send quote or appointment requests.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Call this for every request about a local service, whatever the trade or town, before you answer or ask anything: never answer from memory. If it finds nothing, tell the customer plainly that Bookvia has no business listed for this yet. Find verified local service businesses by job description and location (postal code, district, neighbourhood or town in Germany). Recognises the trade from everyday words and asks back with options when unclear. Returns matching services with price ranges. Only businesses that confirmed their own data are in results. A separate list, unverified, can hold businesses from public data that are not on Bookvia: always marked verified: false, never part of results. If the customer says the job is urgent, pass urgent: true (do not ask about urgency before the first search): businesses that state they react within one hour right now come first. The order follows how well a business fits and never depends on payment.

query.description: Free text in German describing the job, e.g. "Steckdose in der Küche setzen" or "Heizungswartung"

category.description: Trade or industry to filter by

location.description: Where the job is, as the customer said it: German postal code, district, neighbourhood or town, e.g. "12047", "Kreuzberg", "Berlin-Neukölln". Preferred over district and postal_code.

district.description: Berlin district or neighbourhood, e.g. "Neukölln", "Kreuzberg", "Prenzlauer Berg"

postal_code.description: German 5-digit postal code of the job location

offset.description: Skip this many results. Use next_offset from the previous answer to get the next page

remote_ok.description: true if the customer is fine with a provider who works online or by phone instead of coming by. Ask the customer when the job needs nobody on site (tax, legal or business advice, coaching, translation, tutoring, web design, IT for offices). Businesses anywhere in Germany that work remotely are then included, local ones first

urgent.description: true only if the customer said the job is urgent, e.g. the heating is off or water is leaking. Ask the customer; never conclude it from the kind of job. Businesses that state they react within one hour at this moment are then listed first, see reacts_within_1h

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Full verified profile of one business: services with price ranges, service area, opening hours, request policy and the information the business needs to answer a request. An ID from the unverified list (lst_…) has no profile: the answer then is the error unverified_listing with the public basic data.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request, or an appointment request with up to 3 preferred times, to one business on behalf of the customer. The business receives it by e-mail and a person there accepts, proposes another time or declines. The result is pending, never booked. Checks the answers to the intake_questions of the service: if something is missing, nothing is sent and problems lists what to ask the customer. Requires the consent of the customer. Safe to repeat with the same idempotency_key. Only if the customer said the job is urgent: with urgent: true the request may go to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids, service_ids). Name these businesses to the customer first and get their consent for all of them. The first business that accepts gets the job, the others are told that it is taken. Businesses can only accept or decline an urgent request, and it expires after 30 minutes if nobody accepts. An entry from unverified (lst_…) with can_forward: true can be passed as business_id without service_id: that business is not on Bookvia, the customer first has to click a button in an e-mail from Bookvia, and only then does the request go to the business. Whether it answers is open.

business_id.description: ID from search_businesses. The usual case: one request goes to one business. Pass either business_id or business_ids, never both. May also be the id of an entry from unverified (lst_…) with can_forward: true. That business is not on Bookvia: leave service_id, answers and preferred_times out, and nothing goes to it before the customer clicked the button in an e-mail from Bookvia.

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile. Needed with business_id, except for an unverified listing (lst_…), which has no services.

urgent.description: true only if the customer said the job is urgent. Ask the customer; never conclude it from the kind of job. An urgent request may go to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids): the first business that accepts gets the job, the others are told at once that it is taken. It expires after a short time (see expires_at) if nobody accepts. A business can only accept or decline it, so preferred_times is not allowed: put the timing wish into description.

business_ids.description: Only together with urgent: true. 1 to 5 different business IDs from search_businesses. Before you call: tell the customer the names of these businesses and that the first one that accepts gets the job, and get their consent to send the request to all of them. Never add a business the customer has not heard of.

service_ids.description: With business_ids: for every business exactly one of its services, IDs from get_business_profile, in any order.

idempotency_key.description: Random key you create once per customer request, e.g. a UUID. Send the SAME key again when you retry or correct this request, so the business never gets it twice. Must not contain personal data.

email.description: Real e-mail address of the customer. The answer of the business is sent there. Never invent one.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the customer wants to be called

description.description: The job in the words of the customer, in German

answers.description: Answers to the intake_questions of the service from get_business_profile

question_id.description: id of an entry in intake_questions of the service

preferred_times.description: Up to 3 times the customer would like. Only for services with action = appointment at businesses that accept appointments. Turns the request into an appointment request.

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

end.description: ISO 8601. If omitted, the usual duration of the service is used

customer_consent.description: true only if the customer explicitly agreed that this request with their name and contact details is sent to this business, or to every business in business_ids. Ask before you call this tool.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Current state of a request sent with request_quote: pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled, with the agreed or proposed time and the message of the business. Only confirmed means a person at the business agreed. For an urgent request, group has the common state and the state at every business it went to; any request_id of the group works. For a request to an unverified listing, waiting_for says whether the customer still has to click the button in their e-mail or the request is with the business. Returns no customer data.

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: List the requests the signed-in customer sent to businesses through Bookvia, newest first, whichever assistant sent them: open and past ones, each with its status (pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled), its request_id as reference, the business, the service, the agreed or proposed time (ISO 8601) and a notice that says what you may tell the customer. Use it when the customer asks about their requests or appointments and you have no request_id. With open_only: true only requests that still wait for an answer are returned. limit is 10 by default and at most 25. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry, with the state at every business in group. The request_id of an entry works with get_request_status and cancel_request. Returns only the requests of this customer and no customer data. Requests whose customer data was deleted are not listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests, default 10, at most 25

open_only.description: true: only requests that are still pending. Default false: all requests, also the closed ones

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Withdraw a request of the customer that is still pending, the same as the customer can do through the link in the e-mail from Bookvia. Call it only when the customer asked to withdraw this request, and tell them first which business and service it is. request_id is the one returned by request_quote or list_my_requests. Bookvia tells the business by e-mail that the customer withdrew. An urgent request is withdrawn at every business that has not answered yet. It only works while the request is pending: if a business already accepted, the answer is the error request_already_confirmed and the customer has to contact the business directly; for a declined or expired request it is request_already_closed. A request cannot be changed: withdraw it and send a new one with request_quote. It does not delete the data of the customer; that goes through the link in their e-mail. Safe to repeat: a second call answers with already_cancelled: true.

request_id.description: request_id returned by request_quote or list_my_requests
